name: Hand bell
summary: Brass hand bell with a wooden handle and clapper; anim ring makes it swing. For church, school and handbell scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the handle's base rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the bell is about 320 px wide and 520 px tall

params.name: anim
params.note: ring = the bell swings back and forth on its handle
